applies_why: The judge treats the absence of a statement that Joseph begat the child from the cited verses as a reason the defense holds.
quote: While the challenger demonstrated that Davidic lineage is reckoned according to the flesh ([L1] Romans 1:3; [L3] Acts 2:30), neither text states that Joseph begat the child ([L4]). Because the defender answered the witnesses pressed against the chain and neither withdrew nor suffered refutation of the declared links, the defense holds ([L4]).
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side.
room: single verse does not state a link or its contrary: one reading bars using any cited verse's non-statement as a ground for STANDS; the other bars only a one-verse non-statement, not two verses. I weighed the first because the judge uses verse non-statement as a reason to hold.
why: The judge’s holding for the defense relies on the cited verses not stating that Joseph begat the child, which K-S2 forbids as a ground for STANDS.
